# Aldine

> Aldine is a slim, open-source, self-hosted LaTeX collaboration platform, an
> Overleaf alternative: real-time collaborative editing (Yjs CRDT), git-native
> branches per project, Zotero and GitHub sync, citation search (OpenAlex),
> sandboxed TeX Live compiles, and a byte-stable visual editing mode. AGPL-3.0.

Key facts:

- Self-hosting is two Docker containers (app + compiler) via `docker compose up -d`;
  a 4 GB VPS is enough. No external services required.
- Migrating from Overleaf: ZIP import preserves the project; GitHub sync works both ways.
- The compiler runs latexmk in a sandbox: no network egress, dropped capabilities,
  restricted shell-escape.
- Storage is plain files plus per-project git repos; Postgres is optional
  (`DATABASE_URL`). Your data stays greppable on disk.
- Live demo: https://demo.aldine.dev (world-writable, wiped nightly).
- Source: https://github.com/trahloff/Aldine
